# Benchmark: does "acidic residue in the 2'-phosphate pocket" predict the experimentally
# known donor preference across the transhydrogenase fold? End-to-end validation of the
# column mapping used for AIM33.
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AAs = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62 = """ 4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
-1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
 0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
-1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
 1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
MM = np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")], float)
idx = {a: i for i, a in enumerate(AAs)}
GAP = -8.0
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c, -1) for c in s])

def nw_map(s1, s2):
    """global-ish NW, free end gaps on s2 (the longer partner). returns dict: s1 pos -> (s2 pos, aa)"""
    a, b = enc(s1), enc(s2); n, m = len(a), len(b)
    Sub = np.where((a[:, None] >= 0) & (b[None, :] >= 0),
                   MM[np.clip(a, 0, 19)[:, None], np.clip(b, 0, 19)[None, :]], -1.0)
    M_ = np.full((n+1, m+1), -1e9); M_[0, :] = 0.0; M_[:, 0] = np.arange(n+1)*GAP
    jj = np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        cand = np.full(m+1, -1e9)
        cand[1:] = np.maximum(M_[i-1, :-1] + Sub[i-1, :], M_[i-1, 1:] + GAP)
        cand[0] = M_[i-1, 0] + GAP
        M_[i, :] = np.maximum.accumulate(cand - jj*GAP) + jj*GAP
    i, j = n, int(np.argmax(M_[n, :])); mp = {}; ident = tot = 0
    while i > 0 and j > 0:
        if abs(M_[i, j] - (M_[i-1, j-1] + Sub[i-1, j-1])) < 1e-6:
            mp[i] = (j, s2[j-1]); tot += 1; ident += (s1[i-1] == s2[j-1]); i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif abs(M_[i, j] - (M_[i-1, j] + GAP)) < 1e-6: i -= 1
        else: j -= 1
    return mp, 100.0*ident/max(tot, 1), tot

def fetch(ac):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{ac}.fasta", timeout=60); r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

# known donor preference from primary literature / UniProt protein names
BENCH = [
 ("hCYB5R3",      "P00387", "NADH",  "cytochrome b5"),
 ("ratCYB5R3",    "P20070", "NADH",  "cytochrome b5"),
 ("Cbr1 yeast",   "P38626", "NADH",  "cytochrome b5"),
 ("Mcr1 yeast",   "P36060", "NADH",  "cytochrome b5"),
 ("Ncb5or human", "Q7L1T6", "both",  "cytochrome b5 (internal)"),
 ("NR maize",     "P49102", "NADH",  "heme/Mo, intramolecular"),
 ("NR Arabidopsis","P11035", "NADH", "heme/Mo, intramolecular"),
 ("NR N. crassa", "P08619", "NADPH", "heme/Mo, intramolecular"),
 ("NR A. nidulans","P22945", "NADPH","heme/Mo, intramolecular"),
 ("Pga3/Nqr1",    "Q12746", "NADH",  "coenzyme Q6"),
 ("AIM33",        "Q04516", "?",     "?"),
]
A = fetch("Q04516")
POS = [216, 244, 256]
CORE = [185, 186, 188, 191]
acid, basic = set("DE"), set("KR")

print(f"{'protein':16s} {'donor':6s} {'%id':>5s} {'cols':>5s}  {'216':>7s} {'244':>7s} {'256':>7s}   {'GxGxxP':>10s}  call")
rows = []
for nm, ac, donor, acceptor in BENCH:
    if ac == "Q04516":
        res = {p: (p, A[p-1]) for p in POS + CORE}; pid, tot = 100.0, len(A)
    else:
        s = fetch(ac); mp, pid, tot = nw_map(A, s); res = {p: mp.get(p, (None, "-")) for p in POS + CORE}
    r216, r244, r256 = res[216][1], res[244][1], res[256][1]
    core = "".join(res[p][1] for p in CORE)
    pocket = [r216, r244]
    if any(c in acid for c in pocket) and not any(c in basic for c in pocket): call = "NADH"
    elif any(c in basic for c in pocket) and not any(c in acid for c in pocket): call = "NADPH"
    elif any(c in acid for c in pocket) and any(c in basic for c in pocket):    call = "mixed"
    else: call = "neutral"
    lbl216 = f"{r216}{res[216][0]}" if res[216][0] else "-"
    lbl244 = f"{r244}{res[244][0]}" if res[244][0] else "-"
    lbl256 = f"{r256}{res[256][0]}" if res[256][0] else "-"
    print(f"{nm:16s} {donor:6s} {pid:5.1f} {tot:5d}  {lbl216:>7s} {lbl244:>7s} {lbl256:>7s}   {core:>10s}  {call}")
    rows.append((nm, donor, acceptor, pid, lbl216, lbl244, lbl256, call, r216, r244, r256))

# positive control: does the mapping recover the published N. crassa determinants?
nc = [r for r in rows if r[0] == "NR N. crassa"][0]
print(f"\nPositive control, PMID 9750171 names Ser920 and Arg932 in N. crassa NADPH:nitrate reductase.")
print(f"  this mapping gives column 244 -> {nc[5]} and column 256 -> {nc[6]}")

known = [r for r in rows if r[1] in ("NADH", "NADPH")]
ok = sum(1 for r in known if r[7] == r[1])
print(f"\nRule accuracy on enzymes with a stated donor: {ok}/{len(known)}")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5, 5.2))
order = rows[::-1]
cmap = {"NADH": "#1f4e79", "NADPH": "#c00000", "both": "#7b5ea7", "?": "#555555"}
for k, r in enumerate(order):
    nm, donor = r[0], r[1]
    ax.text(-0.5, k, nm, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=9,
            fontweight="bold" if nm == "AIM33" else "normal")
    for c, (lbl, aa) in enumerate(zip(r[4:7], r[8:11])):
        col = "#d9e2f3" if aa in "DE" else ("#f8cfcf" if aa in "KR" else "#eeeeee")
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((c, k-0.4), 0.92, 0.8, color=col, ec="white"))
        ax.text(c+0.46, k, lbl, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5)
    ax.text(3.25, k, donor, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=9, color=cmap.get(donor, "#555"),
            fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(4.35, k, r[7], ha="left", va="center", fontsize=9, style="italic")
for c, t in enumerate(["AIM33 col 216", "AIM33 col 244\n(= rat D239)", "AIM33 col 256\n(= rat F251)"]):
    ax.text(c+0.46, len(order)-0.2, t, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8.5)
ax.text(3.25, len(order)-0.2, "known donor", ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=8.5)
ax.text(4.35, len(order)-0.2, "rule call", ha="left", va="bottom", fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(-5.2, 5.6); ax.set_ylim(-0.8, len(order)+0.9); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("Acidic residue in the 2'-phosphate pocket predicts NADH across the transhydrogenase fold.\n"
             "Blue cell = Asp or Glu, red = Lys or Arg. AIM33 is called NADH through Glu216.", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
